tasks.short: Obtain land values and nearby property sales

steps.what: Locate county land values and nearby-property sales information
Verify property identity, dates, transaction types and source scope
Record the checked values and sales in the existing comparison workpaper
Check the completed workpaper against the retrieved records

tasks.design: Use native geographic and date filters in {OTHER}, the licensed property-data portal, and a reusable comparison sheet in {SPREADSHEET}. The appraiser checks the records and enters the actual evidence; no unattended source scrape or import is implied.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation and comparison-sheet structure consume gathering time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved searches and reusable sheet columns can remove these operations without selecting comparables automatically.
tasks.still_hard: Transaction scope, dates and property identities may not be comparable.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when apparently nearby records are unsuitable valuation evidence.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repetitive evidence handling while preserving source checks.

reach.learn: Keep source identifiers and transaction qualifications visible

evidence.claim: Native property-source filters and reusable workpaper columns can reduce navigation and repeated record structure; local amounts are unmeasured.

assumptions: County sources are read in the task's stated jurisdiction; no equivalence to a particular Dutch register is asserted. The comparison workpaper already supports appraisal and is not an extra gathering log.

The appraiser supplies geographic and date filters in s1 and produces checked parcel identity, sale date, price, transaction qualification and source reference in s2-s3; capture and verification are counted. Missing or conflicting metadata is resolved manually.

Saved filters remove 9 of 30 navigation hours. Existing workpaper columns, fixed source labels and repeated subject-property fields remove 15 of 30 entry hours; actual sales values and source checks remain manual. No machine fill is implied.
Ordinary same-system author saves remain retained without a self-gate. Record gathering overlapping the later market-trend task is allocated only once.
unknowns: Native search coverage and licence restrictions
research_questions: Can saved searches and the current comparison-sheet template remove the specified repeated actions on actual records?

already_counted.description: Enter checked records and verify the completed comparison workpaper

incremental.description: Maintain source filters and the comparison-sheet field structure

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=76, gross 24 less 2 upkeep gives 22 net. Conservative case: inconsistent transaction metadata retains 29 retrieval hours and existing sheet structure leaves only two entry hours removable, retaining 28 entry plus other 40 and 2 upkeep gives 1 net. With compatible source metadata retaining 24 retrieval and 19 entry hours plus other 40 and 2 upkeep, 15 net remains. The large entry cut requires observed repeated structure and cannot be claimed for an already templated workpaper.

tasks.short: Maintain familiarity with local real estate markets

steps.what: Locate current information on local real estate markets
Study local transactions and developments to update market understanding
Discuss market developments with local property professionals

tasks.design: Use native locality and source views in {OTHER}, the existing property-information portal. The appraiser directly studies the material and discusses local context with professionals.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated navigation across local sources takes time before substantive study.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved source views can shorten navigation without substituting a generated market interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Published transactions and professional anecdotes can omit important market segments.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise local context and assess how representative the available evidence is.
tasks.altitude: Reduce source navigation while preserving market learning.

evidence.claim: Native locality and source views can reduce repeated navigation without replacing direct learning.

assumptions: Familiarity is an understanding task, not a newly required market report or contact log. No trailing record is invented without an existing artefact and reader.
The appraiser selects locality, property segment, source and date criteria in s1, with selection and scope checking counted. Missing coverage requires manual source search.
Saved views remove 3 of 20 navigation hours. Reading, contextual interpretation and professional discussion stay fully retained.
Professional discussion is external in this case; internal colleague discussion uses write_internal. Record gathering shared with 21570 is allocated once rather than counted again as new saving.
unknowns: Whether saved views preserve market-segment coverage
research_questions: Can native views reduce navigation without narrowing the appraiser's exposure to local developments?

already_counted.description: Study and contextualise local market developments

incremental.description: Refresh local-source views when coverage changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact questions and information disclosed to the selected external professional; changed confidential content requires reconsideration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=97, gross 3 less 1 upkeep gives 2 net. Conservative case: fragmented segment metadata permits only one navigation hour to be removed, offset by one upkeep hour. With usable locality views removing two navigation hours, 98 hours remain and one upkeep gives 1 net. Study and professional discussion remain unchanged.

tasks.short: Inspect property and determine appraisal value

steps.what: Review location, market and replacement-cost evidence for the property
Inspect properties and assess location, building condition and relevant features
Capture the inspection findings in the existing property workpaper
Determine appraisal value considering the inspection and relevant valuation evidence
Write the value conclusion and property-specific qualifications

tasks.design: Use a native property-document view and existing inspection and conclusion sections in {DOCS}. The appraiser inspects and judges value; the field record and value writing remain separate steps.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reference navigation and repeated workpaper fields consume time around inspection and valuation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and existing form structures can reuse stable identifiers and headings without determining value.
tasks.still_hard: Condition, location effects and uncertain replacement assumptions require direct judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise which observed features materially change the value conclusion.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated workpaper structure while preserving inspection and valuation judgement.

reach.learn: Separate visible observations from unsupported assumptions about defects

evidence.claim: Native views and property-workpaper sections can remove repeated fields and headings; proposed local effects are E1.

assumptions: The inspection findings and appraisal conclusion are existing valuation workpapers. No new inspection log or issued-report send is added.

The appraiser produces property observations in s2 and captures identity, condition, features and qualifications in s3; capture is counted. Missing information is investigated manually and never filled by inference.

The native view removes 1.5 of 15 navigation hours; the inspection form removes 3 of 15 repeated-identity and heading hours; the conclusion structure removes 1 of 10 formatting hours. Each cut corresponds to a different operation.
Ordinary same-system author saves remain retained without self-approval. Market-data gathering shared with 21570 or 21552 is allocated once.
research_questions: Can forms remove the specified repeated structure while retaining all property-specific observations and rationale?

already_counted.description: Capture findings and write the actual value conclusion

incremental.description: Maintain inspection and conclusion form compatibility

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=94.5, gross 5.5 less 1 upkeep gives 4.5 net. Conservative case: existing references and forms are already efficient and unique conclusion writing leaves one formatting hour removable, offset by one upkeep hour. Compatible references removing one navigation hour, form identity reuse removing 2.5 entry hours and conclusion structure removing 0.5 writing hour retain 96 hours and one upkeep gives 3 net. All 60 inspection and value-judgement hours remain.

tasks.short: Collect and analyze real estate market trends

steps.what: Specify relevant market segments, periods and trend measures
Collect relevant market data and check source coverage
Reconcile transaction definitions, exclusions and market-segment comparability
Calculate specified market trends and comparison tables
Analyze trends and challenge apparent changes caused by data composition
Write the existing trend findings and data limitations

tasks.design: Use native source views in {OTHER}, the existing property-data portal, and explicit trend formulas in {SPREADSHEET}. The appraiser checks comparability, interprets the results and writes the existing analysis in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation and manual trend calculations sit between collecting data and interpreting it.
tasks.enabler_now: Saved source views and tested spreadsheet formulas can repeat specified measures without inferring market causes.
tasks.still_hard: Changing sale composition and sparse segments can create misleading apparent trends.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a genuine market change from a measurement or composition effect.
tasks.altitude: Reduce calculation work while preserving market interpretation.

reach.learn: Expose sample coverage and composition changes

evidence.claim: Specified spreadsheet trend formulas and native source views can repeat calculations and navigation; local effects remain unmeasured.

assumptions: The trend findings are the analysis's existing working output, not an extra status report. No automated alert, publication or final send is implied.

The appraiser produces sale dates, prices, segment keys, transaction exclusions, period boundaries and selected statistics in s1-s3, with capture and normalization counted. Missing definitions or inconsistent units return to manual reconciliation before s4.

The 25 calculation hours are actual manual calculation and repeated table assembly, not existing runtime. Source views remove 5 navigation hours; stable analysis headings remove 1 writing hour, independently sized.
Data acquisition shared with 21570 is charged once. Ordinary same-system author saves are fully retained and need no self-gate.
research_questions: Do calculations reproduce independent checks and retain honest coverage limits when transaction composition changes?

already_counted.description: Reconcile data definitions and interpret apparent market changes

incremental.description: Maintain trend-formula tests and source-field mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=69, gross 31 less 3 upkeep gives 28 net. Conservative case: inconsistent source keys retain all 25 collection hours, existing automation leaves only 5 calculation hours removable, and unique qualifications retain all 10 writing hours; other 40 and 3 upkeep give 2 net. Compatible source metadata retaining 22 collection, 7 calculation and 9 writing hours plus other 40 and 3 upkeep gives 19 net. Different retained amounts reflect source compatibility, existing automation and output structure separately.
